en.title: Xbox Game Pass Loses 14 Titles This November — Including GoldenEye 007
en.summary: Get ready to say goodbye to a significant chunk of your Xbox Game Pass library. Fourteen games are set to depart the service in early November 2026, with some fan-favorite titles among the departures.
en.body:
The familiar rhythm of Xbox Game Pass is about to shift once again as Microsoft has announced that 14 games will be leaving the service in early November 2026. This significant culling means players have a limited window to experience these titles before they disappear from the Game Pass library.

Among the notable departures is the beloved N64 classic, **GoldenEye 007**, a title that defined a generation of console shooters and remains a benchmark for its genre. Also heading out the digital door are the chaotic vehicular mayhem of **Wreckfest** and the stylish indie gem **1000xRESIST**. While the full list of departures and their exact removal dates are still being finalized, the Xbox phone app has begun flagging these titles as "leaving soon," prompting a rush for many subscribers.

This influx of departures follows a busy October, which saw titles like **Deep Rock Galactic**, **Full Throttle Remastered**, **Grim Fandango Remastered**, and **A Plague Tale: Requiem** bid farewell to the service. The constant rotation is a hallmark of the Game Pass model, ensuring a fresh catalog of games but also creating a sense of urgency for players to dive into their favorites before they’re gone.

## What This Means for Game Pass Subscribers

The departure of 14 games in a single wave, especially in early November, underscores the value proposition of Game Pass. It’s a constant reminder that while the service offers incredible variety and access to numerous titles, those games aren’t permanently available. For fans who haven't yet played titles like **GoldenEye 007** or **Wreckfest**, this is a final call to action. It also presents an opportunity for those who may have overlooked these games to give them a try, potentially discovering a new favorite before it’s too late. The community is already buzzing, with many sharing their last-minute gaming plans and expressing sadness over the loss of certain titles, while others are eagerly anticipating what new games will fill the void.

## What's Next for Game Pass

While the departures are significant, Microsoft typically replenishes the Game Pass library with new additions shortly after. Specific dates for November's new arrivals have not yet been fully detailed, but players can expect announcements regarding new games coming to the service. Keep an eye on official Xbox channels for the latest updates on what’s new and what’s leaving.
